description: This file defines the Autoloader class for the Opencart System Engine namespace. It manages autoloading of classes by registering namespace-to-directory mappings and loading class files dynamically based on class names.
published:
Opencart	he
amespace	he ull
amespace or	he ile

classes.name: Autoloader
classes.description: Class responsible for mapping namespaces to directories and dynamically loading class files during runtime.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Autoloader and registers the autoload function.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a namespace with its corresponding directory, optionally as PSR-4 standard.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the class file based on its namespace and class name by constructing the appropriate file path and including it.
